svg.text: Sonic The Hedgehog's Gameworld, played on a Mega Drive
Every button on the pad stands in for something the Pico has. The lines say which.
moves the hand around the tablet
taps, which is the pen's tip switch
switches the D-pad between the hand
The hand is on screen the whole time and
parks in the corner while the game has the
D-pad. A pad cannot point, so the hand is
moved rather than aimed at a spot.
Pico photo: Muband, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Pad photo: Joel Trottier, public domain. Both annotated here; see images/NOTICES.
